title: Vanilla Fixes
description: Fixes bugs that should have been fixed in vanilla
body:
### Fixes bugs in Vanilla Minecraft:

*   The Ender Dragon can no longer be easily killed with beds
*   Boats no longer break when falling from certain heights _(Fixed in new Minecraft versions)_
*   Break only one slab when two are in the same block

All features can be enabled/disabled in config. You can **edit config** in Mods section **in game**.

### Config Location:

`YourMinecraftInstance\config\vanillafixes-common.toml`
